seasonal_note: Seasonal context: November and early December reflect pre-Christmas wholesale giftware stocking, which lifts weekly revenue and order volume well above early-autumn baselines.

show_work.definition: Gross revenue minus the value of cancelled (returned) lines.
show_work.caveats: Returns are booked in the week of the cancellation invoice, not the week of the original sale.
show_work.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-14' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-21'

show_work.caveats: One invoice can contain several categories, so orders by category do not add up to total orders.
show_work.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN invoice END) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-14' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-21'

show_work.definition: Gross revenue divided by the number of orders.
show_work.caveats: With a category filter this is category revenue per order that contains the category.
show_work.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN invoice END), 0) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-14' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-21'

show_work.definition: Number of distinct identified customers with at least one sale in the period.
show_work.caveats: Guest orders have no customer ID and are not counted.
show_work.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' AND NOT is_guest THEN customer_id END) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-14' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-21'

show_work.definition: Share of identified customers in the period whose order was not their first order in this dataset.
show_work.caveats: The data starts in December 2009, so customers who bought before then look new. Early months understate this rate and inflate "new" customers.
show_work.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' AND customer_type = 'returning' THEN customer_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' AND NOT is_guest THEN customer_id END), 0) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-14' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-21'

show_work.definition: Returns divided by gross revenue, by value.
show_work.caveats: Returns and sales in the same period are not necessarily the same orders.
show_work.sql: SELECT -SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'return' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'sale' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS value FROM lines WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-14' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-21'

drivers.total_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-14' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-21' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS current, SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-07' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-14' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS previous, COUNT(*) AS rows_scanned FROM lines WHERE ((invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-14' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-21') OR (invoice_date >= DATE '2011-11-07' AND invoice_date < DATE '2011-11-14'))

summary.text: During the week of 2011-11-14, retail performance was strong, delivering a net revenue of £369,129. This represented a week-over-week increase of +£19,006 or +5.4% compared to £350,123 in the previous period. Furthermore, net revenue stood +30.5% above the prior four-week average of £282,931. The business processed 687 orders, marking a notable rise from the 634 orders seen the week before and outpacing the four-week average of 532. However, the average order value moved to £543.20, down -£21.01 or -3.7% from £564.21. Growth was broadly supported across the board, with Bags serving as the top category driver despite a previous comparison of 44750.31, while Netherlands acted as the leading country driver.
